subject: Copywriting
title: Gary Halbert: The Prince of Print
description: A short lesson to help you apply Gary Halbert: The Prince of Print.

hook.text: Gary Halbert mailed 600 million letters over his career.

buildup.text: Halbert wrote from prison after a mail fraud conviction. His prison letters became legendary copywriting lessons.

discovery.text: His 'Boron Letters' to his son taught raw, honest copywriting. Written with nothing but time and a pen.

twist.text: Halbert's most important advice wasn't about copy—it was about lists. 'A starving crowd' beats great copy every time.

climax.text: He lived larger than life and died leaving a cult-like following of direct-response copywriters who still study him.

punchline.text: A starving crowd beats great copy. Find the hunger first.

quiz.question: What did Halbert say was more important than great copy?

details.summary: Gary Halbert was one of the most successful direct-mail copywriters in history, known for his 'Boron Letters' (written from prison to his son) and the coat-of-arms letter that mailed over 600 million copies. His raw, conversational writing style and obsession with mailing lists shaped a...
details.whyItMatters: Halbert proved that the right message to the right list beats polished creative every time. His emphasis on audience selection over clever writing remains the most important lesson in direct marketing.
takeaways: His coat-of-arms letter was mailed over 600 million times
Halbert wrote 'The Boron Letters' from prison as a copywriting education
He prioritized finding the right audience over perfecting the message

faq.question: What was Gary Halbert's coat-of-arms letter?
faq.answer: Halbert sent personalized letters offering people a printed report about the history and heraldry of their family name. The letter was mailed to over 600 million people and became one of the most successful direct-mail pieces ever created.

faq.question: What are 'The Boron Letters'?
faq.answer: A series of letters Gary Halbert wrote to his son Bond from the Boron Federal Prison Camp. They cover copywriting fundamentals, life advice, and marketing strategy. Published online, they became one of the most widely read free resources on direct-response copywriting.
